osm_selection: From the complete Mongolia snapshot, select ways with a highway tag and area != yes whose full line intersects a selected footprint. Retain all highway values, access restrictions, IDs, versions, timestamps and tags; clip in the metric CRS. Do not require a node inside the footprint.
metric_crs_reason: A common Lambert conformal conic centred on the non-holdout sites avoids a UTM zone boundary and Web Mercator's latitude-dependent scale. Projection factors are checked across each footprint before clipping.
footprint: WGS84 geodesic-circle bounding box using each unchanged manifest center and half_km. This baseline footprint is explicit and independent of the historical Earth Engine spherical buffer approximation.

matching.basis: Prospective engineering screening tolerance, pending reference positional-uncertainty assessment. Do not select a radius by looking at baseline matches. If imagery geolocation or labeling uncertainty makes it unsuitable, amend before revealing candidates and report why.
matching.target: Owner-drawn visible corridor centerlines within owner-inspected usable areas, with explicit ambiguous/obscured polygons excluded from both prediction and reference denominators.
matching.overlap: At each tolerance, intersect each line set with the round buffer of the other set. Matched predicted length / total predicted length is precision; matched reference length / total reference length is recall. Clip both sets to the same eligible footprint first.
matching.duplicates: Use a geometric line union within each source and for the MS+OSM union, so coincident duplicates count once. Retain distinct parallel lines and branch arms. Partial intersections contribute only their matched length. Source rows and IDs remain available for audit.
matching.empty_sets: Report zero denominators as undefined with the empty-set condition. Do not award perfect precision or recall to an empty prediction/reference pair.
matching.width: Use centerline distances; retain Microsoft's WidthMeters as source metadata without using it to enlarge tolerance.
matching.independence: Report per-site descriptive lengths and fractions after owner labels. Adjacent segments and pixels are not independent samples.
matching.interpretation: Buffered length overlap does not prove road identity or network connectivity. Baseline gaps do not establish new roads. Neither the MS+OSM union nor a baseline mask is ground truth.

microsoft_date_limit: Archive release and file modification dates are not per-feature imagery acquisition dates; this archive cannot establish new-since dates.
